title: Neurotic
subtitle: Ductilis — lightning, speed, nerves
text: Neurotic blood is Ductilis: nervous energy, conductive motion, and the fine responsiveness of living tissue. Blood charged this way becomes unstable and fast. It seeks discharge and cannot remain still for long without finding a direction to move in. Some practitioners call it exhilarating. Others call it exhausting. The Neurotic enzyme is the modern tool-name for this restless tendency.
